reviews.x: Gorgeous nail color!! I got an ad for these Orly summer polishes and fell in love with the shade kaleidoscope eyes. My order was shipped much quicker than I expected and it arrived before the estimated date as well. Very happy with my purchase!

I have very oily nails, as well as am very hard on them, so polish lasts MAYBE 48 hours before chipping or peeling off completely. I've used Seche Vite in the past with minimum success, although I do like its quick dry time.  Today I spent over an hour in my yard, ripping out weeds and things. Not a single chip on my nails. Very impressed.  A couple things I've found to be helpful: use 2 coats and touch up with an additional coat each day. Also, wrap the polish clear over the end of your nail to

This is the best top coat ever. It drys quick and leaves a "salon look" on your nails. It also helps correct mistakes at the end. Just make sure you don't let the nail color you're using dry completely before you use this. I have been asked many times where I got my nails done when I've used this top coat.

This is so good it’s on subscription. Enough said. But I’ll say more. I no longer fear waking up with smudged nails. This dries down quickly and gives a gel like finish. Worth the price tag. Save the other clear polishes for other things.

Sucks! I thought I was getting the same magical solution that is in the Orly flashdry DROPS but this stuff is AWFUL Thick! tacky sticky and NOT FLASH dry Touch the nail accidentally after application  and it is ruined Not so with the drops Can’t return it. Ordered the drops. With drops I can touch nail immediately and no problem Don’t like this AT ALL

reviews.t: Does not adhere to naked nails
reviews.x: Even after applying this to clean nails, it peels off in one day

This is my FAVORITE color, of all time!!!! I've been going to the same nail salon, for six years and they know it's my go to color. Unfortunately, it seems to have become everyone else's color too and they NEVER have it. I ordered this for my personal use at the salon. I also ordered the matching toe polish. I ALWAYS get compliments on this color. It really pops with my melanin.

Long lasting, quick dry, high shine.  It literally does everything it says and more. Usually I have to use quick dry drops on my nails after top coat (because I’m impatient). But this dries faster than my drops have ever and makes my polish look gorgeous. Never using Etsy again. Will be reordering this as soon as I run out

reviews.t: YES. BUY IT. it's the best top coat ever created
reviews.x: THE BEST TOP COAT EVER!!!! Seriously the best. Super shiny, dries incredibly fast, lasts a long time. They stopped selling this at Sally's beauty supply store and I NEVER find it at ulta. I was starting to think i was never going to be able to have it again but then I found it on here!!!!
Best topcoat and quick drying. Your nails stay shiny and chip free for almost two weeks. Never buying any other and I have tried many ! This is all orly or opi colors and orly topcoat. Love it 😊❤

I have used OPI top Coat (several different kinds). I have also tried Essie top coat... With Essie nail polish and it SUCKS! I always have bubbles, or smudging. This ORLY topcoat is the best I have ever used!!!!!!! It drys very fast and leaves a fantastic finish. NO Bubbles, or Smudging underneath. It makes painting my nails a breeze :)

True red with very subtle glitter. Looks very nice on short nails and seems to stay hard longer than the pale French Manicure colors. May need to be cured longer-I set light a second time on each red coat. The glitter is very small so from 12" away it just looks red.

I love Orly. I’m new to them and am SO impressed. This color however.... I haven’t used much yellow polish and it’s as awkward as I feared. Two coats and it’s still streaky. And while the color through the bottle is bold and fun... it’s not especially pretty on.

My favorite top coat!! My only issue is that my previous one (bought from a cosmetic retail store directly) dried up once it got to a quarter left in the bottle. Still worth it! Others get clumpy or don't dry, but not this!
Complete game changer for the nails!! My paint has not chipped I’m going on my second week today and still looks beautiful i will be ordering two more just in case yall ever stop selling lol

reviews.t: color does NOT look like what is in the description
reviews.x: Was so excited to get this color..color does NOT look like what is in the description, looks almost orange and makes your nails look yellow when applied.  So damn irritated.
This top coat really makes your polish last longer and is super shiny

We bought this black gel to use for gel nail art work.  We are not professionals...just a mom and daughter that do our nails at home.  We did animal spots and zebra stripes on fingers and toes.  This works great.  Just cure it like you do the other gel.  We used it with gelish base and color and had no problem.  It does have a "little" sparkle to it.  Just use this like you would another coat of gel.  Top with top coat gel and cleanse with alcohol.  The possibilities are endless!  Oh yes

I absolutely love this color.... it’s exactly the color I was looking for! However the reason for only 3 stars is because after about 3 uses the bristles on the applicator brush, separated, so the polish goes on uneven in color now. So I won’t use again. I would not recommend this product for that reason, unless I just got a “bad” one.....

Good coverage on this gel polish. Two coats was perfect. You could probably even get away with one coat which is rare in a gel. In some lights this color (snuggle up) matches my skin tone for the perfect mannequin hands manicure; in other lights it looks like a pale purple. I bought this polish because orly is cruelty free.

The colors are as shown, but something was definitely added to these before I got them as both colors reek of acetone. I have owned many Orly polishes in the past and they have not smelled like this. Disappointing to pay full price for less of a product!

Classic black polish with not much more to tell. Super shiny with not other tint. PURE BLACK. To make an evening version you can add some shimmer with a regular nail polish so that you can easily remove it to go back to pure black. It's a must-have.

I purchased two of these. Rose Colored Glasses and Bare Rose. I like sheer, natural colors and these are perfect. Bare Rose is a little more red/pink and Bare Rose is more pink/white. Easy to apply with the thin brush and doesn’t chip.

It’s the Perfect color pink! Let’s be real ladies how often do we actually use up the entire bottle of nail polish? I’m on my second bottle. By far my fav color for my toes. I haven’t found any other color even close. LOVE IT!
This is my favorite color. It goes with everything and it is the one in my collection that gets the most compliments. I am glad that it comes in gel, so my manicures last longer.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the top coat for drying very quickly.
Many reviewers say it leaves a shiny, salon-like or gel-like finish.
Several reviewers report long-lasting, chip-free wear, sometimes up to two weeks.
A few reviewers complain the product is thick, tacky, or sticky rather than fast-drying.
Some reviewers note adhesion or durability problems, such as peeling off naked nails or drying up in the bottle.
